newsitem.title: USA: PairGain to buy Avidia Systems Inc.
newsitem.headline: PairGain to buy Avidia Systems Inc.

text.p: PairGain Technologies Inc said Wednesday it has signed an agreement to acquire Avidia Systems Inc for about $94 million in stock.
Avidia, which develops asynchronous transfer mode digital subscriber access multiplexers, is to become a wholly owned subsidiary of PairGain.
The company said it expects the deal to close by the end of February.
PairGain designs, manufactures and markets high speed digital subscriber line products and systems for service providers and organizations with private communications networks.
